strongest_objection: The fence in the type sentence does not hold the map's own first item. The of says the option becomes unexercisable 'without any party deciding about that option in particular', and the map opens with a bank-holiday decree, which decides about exactly that option, the withdrawal, for every holder at once, and later admits Pour the foundation, where a council votes to withdraw exactly the permission at issue. The author saw this and defended Weekend closure with 'the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect', which is not true of a decree whose text forbids the withdrawal by name. The fence the map actually practices, stated in its boundary_case, is different and better: an expiry decided by a party at the holder's own table (the withdrawn offer, the exploding sheet, the rival's lock-up) is a withdrawal or foreclosure and belongs to the leverage maps, while a rule on a class from an authority not at the table is in. The repair is to write that fence into the of clause (replace 'without any party deciding about that option in particular' with 'without any party at the holder's own table deciding about it') and into Weekend closure's closing sentence, which I have done for the item; nothing else on the map depends on the side-effect defence, and Weekend closure keeps its place at the head of the walk on the argument that actually earns it, that its notice cannot precede it. The second thing wrong is smaller and repaired: Standstill with a term, the protected seed and the stop that the loop and the fork both land on, lists the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days among cases whose renewal belongs to the counterparty, and neither has a counterparty to renew; trimmed to the negotiated cases the mechanism is exact. I tried to collapse Kept on the machine into lead-time-floors' Bridge and Slot flown empty into runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapsing without hours logged is the same case, and could not: Bridge never says the bridge ends the option it holds open, and Stamp's clock never says the stamp can be bought with an exercise emptied of purpose; each now says what it adds. The five wrong case facts (Cyprus's levy, the emergency-use declaration, the amblyopia window, the reconstituted board, waived jurisdiction) are repaired in place and none touches a mechanism.

items.item: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday decree, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended until the deposit levy was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a rival's foreclosure, which decides about this holder, since the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect.
items.why: The mechanism (a closure that works only unannounced, so its notice cannot precede it) is the map's best opening and is real: Greece on Monday 29 June 2015 after the Sunday address, the corralito on Saturday 1 December 2001. Two faults. The Cyprus case is wrong as history: the levy announced on Saturday 16 March 2013 was rejected by parliament on 19 March and never became law; the banks stayed shut until 28 March, after the resolution law of 22 March made the bail-in of Laiki and Bank of Cyprus lawful. And the closing fence is false: a bank-holiday decree forbids the withdrawal by name, so 'the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect' does not hold. The honest fence, which the map's boundary_case already practices for Pour the foundation, is that no party at the holder's own table decided about it. The item also shares its Friday-receivership case with runway-illusions' Cash behind glass and should say what it adds.
items.repair: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable, the mechanism that chose the Friday; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which a party at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided about the holder; the item is in on that fence and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name.

items.item: Bar date in the newspaper: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending and is deemed to have read, as the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication, the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising, and the probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper; the condition lost is a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own; the carrier is the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name; the last intervention that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, since the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp, the date that is written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.
items.why: Satisfies the type: the date is fixed for a class in a proceeding the holder is not in, and constructive notice imputes the reading. The bankruptcy bar date, the opt-out postcard, and the probate creditor window after publication are correctly stated. The addition to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock (a date the holder can read on the stamp versus a date on someone else's docket) is the right separation and holds.

items.item: Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends with the public-health declaration, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.
items.why: Mechanism sound and distinct: the date is on the parent instrument, not the option. One case is wrong as stated. Emergency-use authorizations run under the section 564 declaration, which is a different paper from the section 319 public-health emergency; when the public-health emergency ended in May 2023 the authorizations stood. The correct case makes the item's own point better, since the holder has to know which parent paper carries the date.
items.repair: Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date, and the holder must first find which parent paper carries it; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

items.item: Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is largely correctable by patching the good eye before about seven and largely not after, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.
items.why: The mechanism (the holder cannot be its own witness, so preservation belongs to another hand and the expiry rate is a property of the screening programme) is the map's strangest and should stand. The amblyopia window is overstated as history: the paediatric eye disease trials of the 2000s found meaningful response to patching in seven-to-twelve-year-olds and some in teenagers, so 'largely not after' is the folk version. Soften to what the trials found; the item loses nothing, since a soft window is still a clock the child cannot read.
items.repair: Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

items.item: Last known well: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it, as the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke lost the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, which are treated as expired at the earliest time they could have been; the condition lost is a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids; the carrier is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue; the last intervention that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it; not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.
items.why: Correct as stated: the four-and-a-half-hour window counts from last known well, wake-up strokes were excluded, and the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 used imaging to select unwitnessed-onset patients for alteplase. The undated opened vial is standard pharmacy practice. The type holds: the protocol's timestamp rule, not any party, closes it. It sits near clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Milk on the step, which also reads time from the last witness rather than the event, but that map reads time and this one closes an option on the reading, so it does not restate it; the addition to witness-architectures is the right one.

items.item: Mooted: the option to a decision expires because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules, as the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the pregnancy over before the appeal, the election held before the ballot-access case, the tenant evicted before the housing court sits, the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post; the condition lost is a permission, the justiciability of the claim; the carrier is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no party at the table sets; the last intervention that could have kept it is a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on, so the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.
items.why: DeFunis (1974) and Sosna (1975) are correctly used, and Roe's capable-of-repetition doctrine is correctly named. 'Nobody rules' is slightly loose, since a court does dismiss as moot, but it rules on nothing about the option and the dismissal is forced by the ratio the item names as carrier. Distinct from every neighbour: no date anywhere, the world outruns the forum.

items.item: Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the board approval that lapses when the board is reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.
items.why: Mechanism correct and the addition to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal is real (the ratifier that wanted this deal and was gone). One case is wrong as written: a board approval, once passed, does not lapse when the board is reconstituted; only an approval agreed and not yet voted does, which is what the item's own last intervention ('minuted rather than agreed in the hallway') assumes. Fix the case to match.
items.repair: Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

items.item: Landlord changes: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see, as the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises, the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves, the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen, the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive; the condition lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option; the carrier is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it; the last intervention that could have kept it is recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, which costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement; adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.
items.why: Holds. The unrecorded promise not binding a purchaser without notice is the general rule (a tenant in possession gives inquiry notice in many states, but an oral promise outside the lease fails the statute of frauds anyway, so the simplification is safe). The mirror of term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair is exact: there the successor exercises a term the friend would not, here the successor declines a term the friend gave.

items.item: Chair grown over: the option to return rests on a vacancy that the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle without anyone declining the return, as the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization, the budget line reallocated at year end, the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed, the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire; what expires is the return to the seat, since employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside; the condition lost is a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder; the carrier is the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns; adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents, the case in which no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed; not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.
items.why: Holds and is the map's cleanest counterparty-side capability loss: the counterparty stays, remembers the holder, and has nowhere to put them. Distinct from Landlord changes (counterparty replaced) and from Session ends by the neighbour test below. The addition to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant (absorbed rather than opposed) is real.

items.item: Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the syndicate's pro-rata rights that lapse if not exercised with the round, the tender offer's minimum condition, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and pro-rata cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.
items.why: Michigan's sixty-day signature validity and California's hundred-and-sixty-day statewide window are correct, and the tender offer's minimum condition fits. The pro-rata case fails the type twice: a pro-rata right is one holder's option, not a coordination of many yeses, and a holder who does not exercise it with the round has declined it. Drop that case and correct the modality sentence that leaned on it.
items.repair: Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and tender cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

items.item: Outgrown the buyer: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining, as the company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done, the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two, the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed; the condition lost is a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option; the carrier is the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises; the last intervention that could have kept it is the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make; analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so the item stands as a mechanism and not a count; adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.
items.why: Marked analytical and honestly fenced ('every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more'). 'Cannot pay at all' is strong, since a buyer can borrow past its market value, but the item names the ceilings as a ladder (market value, wage cap, concentration limit, approval ceiling) and the mechanism, a counterparty lost by the holder's own trajectory, is distinct from every neighbour and is the walk's first holder-run clock. Keep as the wild priority it is.

items.item: Pour the foundation: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for, as the building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote, the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date, the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week; the last intervention that could have kept it is the hole in the ground before the vote, which is an exercise begun rather than a filing made, so the option can be preserved only by starting to use it; adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own; not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right, since here one beginning vests it for good.
items.why: Vested-rights doctrine is correctly stated: the majority rule vests on substantial construction in reliance on a valid permit, Washington vests on a complete application, the nonconforming use must exist on the effective date. The fence question raised at Weekend closure applies here too (the council's vote decides to withdraw exactly this permission) and is answered the same way: a rule on a class by a body not at the holder's table. Distinct from Slot flown empty as the item says, one beginning vests for good.

items.item: Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.
items.why: The eighty-percent rule, the early-2020 empty flights before the waiver, five-year nonuse forfeiture under prior appropriation, and three-year trade mark abandonment are all correct. But runway-illusions' Stamp's clock already carries 'the license that lapses without hours logged', which is this item's mechanism in one case, so the item must say what it adds rather than leave the reader to find the overlap. What it adds is real: the upkeep is the exercise emptied of purpose, at the full exercise price, so the holder buys the stamp's time by burning the permission.
items.repair: Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

items.item: Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the mobilized reserve whose readiness the treasury pays for by the day; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry or a payroll that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder, since here it falls on the good.
items.why: The map's new member and its best mirror; the vaccine cold-chain figures (months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured) are right and the clinic's tray is exactly the mechanism. One case does not belong: 'the mobilized reserve whose readiness the treasury pays for by the day' is an upkeep bill, which is Kept on the machine's carrier, not a spoilage of the readied good. The mobilized reserve does belong to this item, but by a different clock: it cannot be held mobilized through the harvest it was drawn from. Repair the case and the carrier so the item does not borrow its neighbour's clock.
items.repair: Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day, since here it falls on the good.

items.item: First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.
items.why: Mechanism real and the merge recorded in the ledger (waived defence plus the conference talk) is stronger than either half. One case is wrong as law: only the objection to jurisdiction over the person (and venue) is waived by omission from the first response; subject-matter jurisdiction is never waived. The European absolute-novelty and United States one-year grace cases are correct.
items.repair: First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

items.item: Rollback horizon: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence and it closes without anyone deciding to close it, as the migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, the merger reversible until the first combined payroll, the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there, the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart, the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit; the condition lost is a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here; the carrier is the first write, which is performed by the new state in the ordinary course and is not a decision about the reversal at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth; adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment at which one of them is lost, and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible; not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.
items.why: Holds. The first write the old state cannot read is a consequence, not a rule, which is what separates it from First or never in the neighbour test below, and expand-and-contract as the last intervention is the right operator's answer with its price named. The pointer to undo-costs (a sibling in this fleet, not yet admitted) is the correct division of labour.

items.item: Kept on the machine: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's, as the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed, the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end, the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider; the condition lost is a capability, the eligibility or the workings; the carrier is the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill; the last intervention that could have kept it is a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each of which treats the bridge's start as the option's deadline; the ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified; adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open; not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm nobody signs.
items.why: Holds, with the ECMO limits honestly marked as centre practice. It does not restate lead-time-floors' Bridge: Bridge holds the function at a worse rate and is faked by the bridge that becomes the crossing, while this item's bridge ends the option it was holding open, which Bridge never says. The boundary_case correctly keeps the dewaterable-at-a-price mine out and the flooded-past-reopening mine in.

items.item: Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the leave of absence that dates a job which had no date, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the temporary restraining order's fourteen days, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
items.why: The protected seed and the walk's terminus, and its core (a pause taken to keep an option open gives the situation a date it did not have, and the renewal belongs to the counterparty who now knows the pause's worth) is right for the tolling agreement, the negotiated leave, and the takeover standstill. Two of its cases contradict the mechanism: the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days are terms fixed by a rule, with no counterparty to renew and no concession to pay, so they are Stamp's clock, not this. Keep them only as the statutory form the item must distinguish itself from, so the loop and the fork that land on this item land on the negotiated case.
items.repair: Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs, the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; the statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it, and they are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.

neighbor_test.separating_case: Both clocks are the holder's own next act on a neighbouring matter, and the author separates each from other stops but never from the other. Take one acquirer the week after closing. It files the combined group's first tax return with the consolidated election, and by rule the election binds for every later year: the option to file separately is gone by First or never, since a rule written in the tax code and not in the merger agreement tied the option to a position in a sequence, and a consent from the authority would give it back. The same week it runs the first combined payroll: the option to unwind the merger is gone by Rollback horizon, since the two payroll histories are now one record the old entities cannot read, and no consent from anyone returns it. The tell is to ask whether a waiver could reopen the option. If yes, the clock was a rule of order and the holder lost by not knowing the order; if no, the clock was a consequence in the world and the holder lost by the new state's ordinary act. The two do not collapse: repeal the rule and First or never's option returns, repeal every rule and the payroll still cannot be split.

boundary_case: The plain statute of limitations is the tempting nonmember: the claim becomes unexercisable on a date, the holder never declined, and no party decided about this claim in particular, so it passes the type sentence. It is out, and the map's own items say why: it is runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the instrument that grants it. What every item here carries is a clock written somewhere other than on the option: on a docket (Bar date), a parent paper (Emergency over), a register (Landlord changes), the rules of procedure (First or never), a chemistry (Thawed), the new state's first write (Rollback horizon), the machine (Kept on the machine), or nowhere legible at all (Weekend closure, Mooted, Patch before seven). The one exception is deliberate, Standstill with a term, where the holder wrote the only clock in the situation and then handed its renewal away, and that exception is what the walk was built to reach. So the ruling is that the map's live fence, beyond the one repaired above, is 'the clock is not on the option', and Bar date in the newspaper sits on it correctly: the date is on the docket, and the rule of constructive notice pretends it was on the option.

seriation.note: The walk holds and I argue no reorder. Weekend closure keeps the opening, since the argument for its place, the one clock no holder can read before it strikes, does not depend on the side-effect defence repaired above. Outgrown the buyer as the last clock the holder runs unknowingly, immediately before the hinge at Pour the foundation where the holder first starts a clock on purpose, is the walk's best placement and is what makes the second half legible. Slot flown empty → Thawed to be ready is the consequential adjacency and the edge earns it. The one adjacency I tested and let stand is Landlord changes → Chair grown over → Petition that goes stale: the neighbour test shows Chair grown over is closer in kind to Session ends (a counterparty cadence that kills a pending matter with no recorded no) than to either of its neighbours, but the axis is what the clock is made of, not who runs it, and on that axis a transfer, a planning cycle, and a coordination's decay are correctly consecutive. With Standstill trimmed to its negotiated cases the terminus is exact: the walk ends at the one clock the holder wrote.

edges.why: A real conditional: the antecedent (the drawn thing spoils once readied) fails for the flight's fuel and the irrigated acre, and the label says so. State allocations that were reclaimed when unordered in 2021 are documented. This is the incompatibility form_inference claims, and the bare walk could not show it.

Conditional with a failing antecedent (a pause shorter than one planning cycle preserves the chair). The tolled claim's reassigned witnesses is a loose instance, since that is evidence decaying rather than the counterparty re-planning, but the furlough and the retooled line carry it.

This closes the loop, so it must carry a mechanism, and the one given ('asking to return would reveal that there is nothing to return to') is a motive attributed to the holder, not a mechanism in the situation. The mechanism that makes the pause renew itself is structural: the renewal is asked of the hand that signs the paper (counsel, the personnel office), not of the hand that owned the chair, so a party with no seat to give can grant it, and each grant reads to the holder as proof the option still stands. Stated that way the antecedent can fail (a renewal asked of the chair's owner breaks the loop) and the loop is a claim rather than a mood.
edges.repair_label: If the chair is gone, the renewal is still available, since it is asked of the hand that signs the paper, the adversary's counsel, the personnel office, the lender's workout desk, and not of the hand that owned the chair, so a party with no seat to give can grant it and each grant reads to the holder as proof the option still stands; the pause then renews itself past the point where it preserves anything, and the holder pays a concession each term for a paper right; the loop is broken only by a return dated inside the first cycle, or by a renewal asked of the chair's owner rather than the paper's, which is the question the holder rarely puts.

edges.why: A passage between levels, correctly conditioned: where the ratifier is standing (a registrar who counts on receipt) the bound vanishes and the petition's own decay is the only clock. 'Bounded above by its ratifier's calendar' is a real claim and is the inference the pile could not make.

Real and operator-true: dual writes and a parallel payroll accrue drift between two records that each claim to be the truth, so the reversal now expires at the bridge's failure. The trade of a clock made of events for a clock made of harm is the second passage and it holds; its antecedent fails whenever the holder does not extend the horizon.

The fork's first door. Conditional on vesting-by-construction, and the label names the jurisdiction where the antecedent fails (Washington's vesting on application). 'Slot flown empty for a single season' is exactly right: one emptied exercise rather than a standing one.

The fork's second door. Development agreements, moratorium exemptions, and permit extensions are real dated deferrals whose renewal belongs to the body changing the rule, so the holder's choice at the fork (pay the exercise to keep the clock its own, or pay nothing now and hand the clock to the counterparty) is a genuine inference. With Standstill trimmed to its negotiated cases this edge lands squarely.

modality_problems: Type sentence: 'without any party deciding about that option in particular' excludes Weekend closure and Pour the foundation as written; the fence the map practices is 'without any party at the holder's own table deciding about it', and the of clause should say so.

Weekend closure asserts the Cypriot holiday 'was extended until the deposit levy was law'; the levy announced on 16 March 2013 was rejected by parliament on 19 March and never became law, and the banks reopened on 28 March after the resolution law of 22 March made the bail-in lawful. Repaired.

Weekend closure's closing fence ('the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect') is false of a decree that forbids withdrawals by name. Repaired to the table fence.

Emergency over ties the emergency-use authorization to 'the public-health declaration'; the authorizations run under a separate declaration and outlived the public-health emergency's end in May 2023. Repaired.
Patch before seven's 'largely not after' overstates the amblyopia window; the paediatric trials of the 2000s found response in seven-to-twelve-year-olds and some in teenagers. Softened.

Session ends' 'board approval that lapses when the board is reconstituted' is wrong of a passed resolution; repaired to the approval agreed and not yet minuted, which the item's own last intervention assumes.
Petition that goes stale's pro-rata case is one holder's option declined by non-exercise, not a coordination; cut from the item, and the modality sentence that called it observed corrected.
First or never's 'objection to the court's jurisdiction' is waivable only as to the person and venue; subject-matter jurisdiction is never waived. Repaired.

Thawed to be ready's mobilized reserve 'paid for by the day' is an upkeep bill, Kept on the machine's carrier, not a spoilage; repaired to the reserve that cannot be held through the harvest, and the carrier's 'or a payroll' replaced with 'or a season'.
Standstill with a term's family-leave and restraining-order cases have no counterparty who renews; kept only as the statutory form the item distinguishes itself from and assigned to Stamp's clock.

Edge Chair grown over → Standstill with a term rested on a motive ('asking to return would reveal that there is nothing to return to') rather than a mechanism; relabelled on the structural fact that the paper's renewal is asked of a different hand than the chair's owner.
best_unresolved_seed: The keeping is the tell. Standstill with a term says it outright (the counterparty 'now knows what the pause is worth to the holder'), Kept on the machine's pump bill is visible to anyone who can read a budget line, Thawed to be ready's tray is counted at closing, and Slot flown empty's empty flight is in the regulator's ledger by construction, so on the second half of the walk every upkeep that preserves an option also publishes its price to the party best placed to charge for it. The map points at this and does not contain it: a list of the ways an option's upkeep is legible to a counterparty, with the carrier of the legibility (the ledger, the bill, the renewal request, the discard count), whether the holder can keep the option without publishing it, and what the counterparty does with the reading. It connects to walkaway-manufactures' Kettle on the hob, where the kept alternative is read by the party keeping it warm, and it would explain why the last intervention on this map is so often 'ask before they learn it is needed'. The ledger's 'Read off the crowd' seed is the same thing from the other side, an expiry the holder can date only from others' exits, and both need a case with a carrier of its own before either is an item.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the fence that admits Weekend closure and Pour the foundation (no party at the holder's own table decided, rather than no decision about the option), trimming Standstill with a term to the cases where the renewal belongs to the counterparty, correcting five case facts in place, and relabelling the loop-closing edge on a mechanism rather than a motive; no item cut.
